description: Connect an agent to an MCP server that signs people in through the browser,
such as Notion or Atlassian. Each person connects their own account:
the grant is theirs alone, and other members connect separately when asked.
Use ``request_mcp_token`` for servers that take a pasted bearer token and
``attach_mcp_server`` for public servers. Members can use this on shared
agents and built-in Daimon; repointing an existing server name at another
Posts a requester-only card; its button opens a private sign-in link that
expires in ten minutes. Finishing sign-in stores the grant for that person
and attaches the server to the agent, not this session's toolset. Check
tool availability before promising use here. Pass the waiting task as
`pending_task` so it resumes after the connection is made.

channel_id.description: Compatibility field; origin controls the posting destination.

pending_task.description: The work that should run once the value is saved, in the person's words — a script, a file, a question. Omit it when they only asked to save or replace the key; the request itself is never a task.

server_name.description: Connection name; reuse at a new URL replaces it (admin if shared).

url.description: MCP endpoint URL that signs people in through OAuth, e.g. https://mcp.notion.com/mcp.
